# Save procedural skills (skills.save)

## categories

[
  "skills",
  "memory"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "expected_output": {
      "id": "sum-check",
      "path": ".skills/sum-check.json",
      "provenance": {
        "origin": "agent"
      },
      "replaced": false
    },
    "id": "save",
    "input": {
      "examples": [
        "Input [2, 3, 5] gives 10."
      ],
      "id": "sum-check",
      "steps": [
        "Run python.run with print(sum([2, 3, 5])).",
        "Inspect stdout and exit_code."
      ],
      "summary": "Check an arithmetic sum using Python.",
      "tags": [
        "arithmetic",
        "python"
      ],
      "title": "Check a sum"
    },
    "title": "Save a sum-check procedure"
  }
]

## description

Save a named procedural note with ordered steps and examples. Existing ids require replace=true. Notes are UTF-8 JSON in .skills/<id>.json in your workspace and survive checkpoints. They are data, never executable registrations. Use skills.list to find notes and skills.get to retrieve them.

## failure_modes

[
  {
    "condition": "Invalid, linked, oversized or damaged skill data, or duplicate save without replace.",
    "recovery": "Inspect the workspace note, repair it or explicitly replace it. Use a fresh slug for a new skill.",
    "symptom": "A validation or capability error."
  }
]

## id

skills.save

## limitations

[
  "At most 1000 store entries and 100000 UTF-8 bytes per note; list pages contain at most 50 summaries.",
  "Agent-owned workspace files can be edited directly. Invalid stored data is refused visibly; replace=true can repair a damaged note.",
  "Procedures are not validated executable tools. No new permissions, automatic execution or cross-run sharing."
]
